g.text: Perform the resolution of the project template.
Sanitize and validate the project name then create and save the Project aggregate root.
The transaction for the creation of the project ends here.
This event has been caused by the CreateProjectInput.
Transactional event listener creating a new transaction.
Used to initialize the semantic data of the project to an empty state.
Create and save the SemanticData aggregate root
The transaction for the creation of the blank semantic data ends here.
This event has been caused by the ProjectCreatedEvent.
The semantic data have not been linked to the project yet.
Transactional event listener creating a new transaction.
Used to link the project to its semantic data.
The transaction for the creation of the link between a project and its semantic data ends here.
This event has been caused by the SemanticDataCreatedEvent.
After this event, the project can, for the first time, be considered usable
Transactional event listener creating a new transaction.
Used to initialize the project with meaningful data.
Perform the resolution of the semantic data initializer for the template.
Initialize the semantic data depending on the template selected.
After that, the semantic data are persisted with the proper content.
The transaction for the initialization of the semantic data ends here.
This event has been caused by the ProjectSemanticDataCreatedEvent.
Transactional event listener creating a new transaction.
Used to create some initial representation(s) for the studio template.
Transactional event listener creating a new transaction.
Used to add the relevant libraries as dependencies of the semantic data.
Used to add dependencies to the semantic data.
The transaction for the addition of the dependencies ends here.
This event has been caused by the SemanticDataCreatedEvent.
